description: This file defines the OrganizationService class in the OrangeHRM system, which manages operations related to organization data such as retrieval and saving general information, acting as a service layer that interacts with the OrganizationDao data access object.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling organization-related operations such as fetching and saving organization general information.

methods.name: getOrganizationDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the OrganizationDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setOrganizationDao
methods.description: Sets the OrganizationDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves general information about the organization.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided organization general information, potentially throwing a TransactionException.
